question: Should Workspaces permanently ship charting as a bundled trusted `builtin:chart` widget instead of leaving charts to sandboxed custom widgets?
rationale: This PR expands the plugin's first-party widget and agent-authoring contract; correctness review cannot determine that lasting product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor The Built-In
options.body: Accept `builtin:chart` as a plugin-owned trusted widget after locale synchronization and final-head live Workspaces proof.

options.title: Keep Charts Custom
options.body: Decline the permanent built-in and retain charting through the existing sandboxed custom-widget path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor The Built-In
recommendation.body: Accept `builtin:chart` as a plugin-owned trusted widget after locale synchronization and final-head live Workspaces proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available Workspaces feature-history owner for coordinating the decision, although final product authority still belongs to a repository maintainer.
